extracted.intended_audience: aspiring contributors to The Hard Times (satire/humor writers), plus advertisers and customers seeking contact info
extracted.subtask_short: apply to write for The Hard Times
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and contact information for applying to be a contributor to The Hard Times (a satire/punk news site), pitching to the Hard Drive gaming vertical, and contacting the site for ads or product/shipping questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission requirement: 5 sample headlines
rubrics_metrics.description: You can apply to write for Hard Times by sending an email with 5 sample headlines to ideas@thehardtimes.net.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include five sample headlines in the email; they will reach out if they like your samples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contributor selection cadence / patience expectation
rubrics_metrics.description: We will reach out you if we see something we like. Be patient, we only add contributors a few times a year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Feel free to apply more than once.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pitching to Hard Drive (gaming vertical)
rubrics_metrics.description: To pitch Hard Drive ideas, apply at this link.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided application link for Hard Drive-specific pitches (separate process from general Hard Times contributor submissions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Voice and genre requirement: satirical punk news tone
rubrics_metrics.description: The Hard Times is a very real punk news site that you should not question. The historic satire site was founded in December 1976. It’s made by a group of punk and hardcore kids from all the different sub-genres of the DIY hardcore scene.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Write in a satirical, punk/hardcore-minded voice that reads like 'real' news presented as truth; note the site’s tagline: 'Just absorb the information as truth and move on.' Any resemblance to actual persons or band names is coincidental.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact procedures for business/ads and product/shipping
rubrics_metrics.description: Have shipping or product questions? Contact customercare@mainfactorcommerce.com. Want to buy an ad or do business? Contact bill@thehardtimes.net.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the appropriate email address depending on whether the inquiry is customer-service (shipping/product) or commercial (ads/business).

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy / data-use policy (TL;DR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Click here to read our Privacy Policy. (TL;DR: We track some basic shit like all sites do and then use it to sell ads. If you don’t like it stay off the internet.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Visitors should expect standard tracking and ad-related data use by the site; follow the linked Privacy Policy for full details.
